text:
helen: quick roundup 10m1 I'm assembling the relnotes for the March docs push. Need a short migration snippet for embeddings, a small FAQ line, and to sweep for absolute vendor links.
raj: which files you want us to touch?
helen: start with sdk/js/embeddings.md, sdk/python/embeddings.md, guides/migrations/embed-streaming.md, and changelog/2026-03. Also search for marketplace.* absolute links and stale anchors.
tiffany: I'll handle the snippets. Planning clear BEFORE/AFTER diffs + a tiny sync helper. Keep examples minimal so they sit nicely in the relnotes.
helen: include a one-line Known issue for Dedicated: "Routing fallback may hit beta variants and surface intermittent 503s; pin to stable model for critical routes." Sales/support flagged a couple tickets.
support: confirming 1 we have two open Dedicated tickets referencing 503s during fallback windows. That Known issue will help CS triage.
raj: running linkcheck now. Found a vendor marketplace URL that 404s and two moved headings under guides/. I'll patch anchors and canonicalize external links to docs.redwood.ai/vendor-integrations.
tiffany: snippet plan: show streaming usage removed -> explicit non-stream pattern + helper and mention token accounting change. JS sample I intend to add: 
```js
// BEFORE (streaming)
for await (const chunk of client.embeddings.streamCreate({ model: 'embed-legacy', input })) {
  process(chunk)
}
// AFTER (sync helper + explicit non-stream)
async function embedSync(client, model, input) {
  return await client.embeddings.create({ model, input, stream: false })
}
const vec = await embedSync(client, 'embed-new', text)
```
helen: good. please also add a 1-line callout: "Disabling streaming can increase token accounting per request; consider batching or prefix/KV caching (see Optimize -> batching)."
tiffany: will do. I'll open a PR with tests that exercise the helper in both js/python so snippet playground CI covers formatting.
raj: patched the anchors and swapped the absolute links to canonical docs. Pushed link-only commit to the branch.
docs-bot: New PR created: #5899 by tiffany - https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5899
helen: add to the changelog a tiny Code Diff block (BEFORE / AFTER) since readers scan for code. Also include the Dedicated caveat in Known issues and a pointer to Optimize batching.
tiffany: adding deprecation note: "Streaming-based embeddings are deprecated; migration window: 30 days before erroring." Keeping language soft yet clear.
support: we'll update internal runbooks to mention pinning models for Dedicated customers until the routing fallback is hardened.
helen: CI is flaky on snippet playground occasionally; thanks for the tests. If CI passes I'll merge and ship. Tag thread resolved after merge.
raj: CI green on link checks.
tiffany: tests passed, opened PR, awaiting review.
docs-bot: CI passed for #5899 1 ready for review.
helen: final editorial pass done. Merging now unless anyone objects.
raj: :+1: from me.
support: thanks all, that Known issue note should reduce noisy tickets.
helen: merging and scheduling deploy. Closing this thread after the merge completes.
